C: › a small safety part in an electrical device or piece of machinery that causes it to stop working if the electric current is too high, and so prevents fires or other dangers

› a string or piece of paper connected to a firework or other explosive product by which it is lit, or a device inside a bomb that causes it to explode after a fixed length of time or when it hits or is near something
導火索；導火線引信；信管

I or T: › to (cause to) melt (together) especially at a high temperature
› UK When an electrical device or piece of machinery fuses, or when someone or something fuses it, it stops working because the electric current is too high.
（使）（因保險絲熔斷而）停止工作

example: My hairdryer's stopped working - I think the fuse has blown (= broken).
我的吹風機壞了——我想可能是保險絲斷了。
Have you tried changing the fuse?
你有沒試過換根保險絲？
He lit the fuse and ran.
他點燃了導火索後就跑了。
Genes determine how we develop from the moment the sperm fuses with the egg.
從精子和卵子結合的那一刻起，基因就決定了我們會如何成長。
The bones of the skull are not properly fused at birth.
出生的時候頭骨結合得並不緊密。
In Istanbul, East and West fuse together in a way that is fascinating to observe.
在伊斯坦堡，觀察東西方的融合是件令人興味盎然的事。
The heat of the fire fused many of the machine's parts together.
熾灼的大火把機器的很多部件都熔化在了一起。
Either my headlights have fused or the bulbs have gone.
要麽是車前燈的保險絲斷了，要麽是燈泡壞了。
The kids were messing around with the switches and they fused the lights.
孩子們瞎搗鼓開關，結果把燈的保險絲燒斷了。

NONE: › a container holding several fuses, such as all the fuses for the electrical system of a single house
保險絲盒
› An electrical device or a piece of machinery that is fused has a fuse in it.
（電器或機器）裝有保險絲的
› the main body of an aircraft
飛機機身

example: A close inspection revealed minute cracks in the aircraft's fuselage and wings.
經過細緻的檢查，發現飛機的機身和機翼上都有細小的裂縫。

NONE: › used to describe a body part that is wide in the middle and narrow at each end
紡錘狀的，梭狀的
› a British soldier of low rank who is in the infantry
（英國的）步兵團士兵
› a large number of bullets fired at the same time or one after another very quickly
（子彈的）齊射，連發

example: a fusillade of automatic fire
自動武器的火力齊射
formal figurative A fusillade (= sudden large amount) of questions greeted the president at this afternoon's press conference.
在今天下午的新聞發布會上，總統遭到了連珠炮一般的提問。

NONE: › a type of pasta in the shape of small twisted pieces
螺旋通心粉
› an occasion when two or more things join or are combined
融合；結合；熔合；合併

example: nuclear fusion
核聚變
Their music is described as "an explosive fusion of Latin American and modern jazz rhythms".
他們的音樂被描述爲「拉丁美洲和現代爵士節奏的爆炸性融合」。

S or U: C1 [ S or U ] a show of anger, worry, or excitement that is unnecessary or greater than the situation deserves
緊張不安；大驚小怪；過分激動
› mainly US make a fuss over sb to give someone a lot of attention and treat them well
對（某人）關懷備至；對（某人）體貼入微

U: › [ U ] attention given to small matters that are not important

I: › [ I ] to give too much attention to small matters that are not important, usually in a way that shows that you are worried and not relaxed
（爲小事）過於煩惱，過度焦慮；過於關注（細節）

example: She made such a fuss when Richard spilled a drop of wine on her blouse!
理查將一滴酒濺在她的襯衫上，她好一陣大驚小怪。
It's all a fuss about nothing.
這完全是無謂的大驚小怪。
I don't see what the fuss is about - he seems like a fairly ordinary-looking guy to me.
我看不出來爲甚麽那麽激動——在我看來他不過是一個長相普通的傢夥。
We tried to arrange a ceremony with as little fuss as possible.
我們試圖安排一個盡可能低調的儀式。
She doesn't see her grandchildren very often so she makes a real fuss of them when she does.
她不怎麽經常見到孫子們，所以見到時往往對他們非常寵愛。
The article was entitled "Making up with the minimum of fuss: a five-minute beauty routine that every busy woman should know".
這篇文章題目爲「費心最少的化妝——每位忙碌女性都應該知道的五分鐘日常美容程序」。
Please, stop fussing - the food's cooking and there's nothing more to do until the guests arrive.
別瞎忙活了——飯正做著，客人們來之前沒甚麽要做的了。
It irritates me the way she's always fussing with her hair!
她老是擺弄自己的頭髮，真讓人受不了。

NONE: › to give a person or animal too much attention because you want to show that you like him, her, or it
過分寵愛；過分關注

example: She's always fussing over that son of hers as if he were a little boy.
她總是過分寵愛那個兒子，就好像他還是個小孩子一樣。

NONE: › a person who is often not satisfied and complains about things that are not important
挑剔的人

example: "I can't eat this meat - it's too tough." "Stop being such a fussbudget and eat your dinner!"
「我吃不了這塊肉，太硬了。」「別那麼挑剔，吃你的晚飯！」

NONE: › a person who is often not satisfied and complains about things that are not important
挑剔的人

example: "I can't eat this meat - it's too tough." "You old fusspot - give it here and I'll eat it!"
「我吃不了這塊肉，太硬了。」「你這個挑剔的老傢夥——給我，我來吃！」

NONE: C2 not easily satisfied, or having very high standards about particular things
過分挑剔的；難以滿足的
› having too much decoration and too many small details, in a way that is not stylish
過分裝飾的，過於繁瑣的
› US A fussy baby is unhappy or difficult to please.
（嬰孩）難以取悅的

example: All my children were fussy eaters.
我所有的孩子都挑食。
He's so fussy about the house - everything has to be absolutely perfect.
他對房子太挑剔了——所有東西都必須絕對完美。
"Why am I still single?" "You're too fussy - that's your problem!"
「我怎麼還是單身？」「你太挑剔了―這就是你的問題！」
They've got those curtains that tie up with big bows - they're a little bit fussy for my taste.
他們那些窗簾都打著大蝴蝶結——在我看來裝飾得有點花哨。
It seems that the baby is always fussy at dinnertime.
那個小孩好像在吃晚飯時總是很難纏。

NONE: › a thick, rough cotton cloth that lasts for a long time
粗斜紋棉布
› not fresh and smelling unpleasant especially because of being left slightly wet
發黴的；有黴味的
› old-fashioned in ideas and beliefs
古板的；守舊的

example: This room smells slightly fusty - I think I'll open a window.
這個房間有些黴味——我覺得應該打開一扇窗戶。
Rupert's father belongs to some fusty old gentleman's club where they don't allow women in.
魯珀特的父親是某個守舊的老年紳士俱樂部的會員，他們不允許女性加入。
